# Security Policy 🔒

## Supported Versions
Currently supported versions:
- Latest STABLE version

## Reporting a Vulnerability
If you find a security issue:

DO NOT open a public issue.

Instead:
- Contact the developer privately (GitHub or email if available)

## What to include
- Description of the issue
- Steps to reproduce
- Possible impact

## Response Time
I will try to respond as soon as possible.

Thanks for helping keep PyRomusa AI safe 🙏
